why_trail.why: Handoff verified complete and baseline reproduced at 1744/2/0. Design settled: removing the supplement collapses render's (file,line) join to identity, so entity_symbol_join would compare a symbol against itself - route 1, re-basing it on an independent source-derived walk inside checks.py, is the disposition, to be proved by breaking each side in turn. Context seam recorded at e-m0-context-1 and declined with a stated reason.

Line base declared per file by an extraction-window statement carrying line_base and the half-open window; both production read sites (render.source_line, checks.StoreScan) convert through the declaration instead of an unexplained +1. RED 5 failed at 8029a4ea, GREEN 5 passed at 74ccd88b; code_map suite 57 passed. Seam recorded at e-m1-line-base-2 and declined.

Five of the six measured gaps now ride the contains statement as a 'd' block; kind reproduces the supplement's own rule so no rendered word moves when the stage goes. RED 8 failed at 88870de2, GREEN 10 passed at 22d25531, code_map suite 62 passed. Seam e-m2-def-schema-1 recorded and declined.

All six measured gaps are now in one schema: declares carries a value's annotation and value (annotation-only fields included, which had no statement at all), and the extraction window carries loc, doc body and __all__. declares is deliberately not contains so a constant demands no page. RED 3 failed at 91da2500, GREEN 14 passed at 0782ff2b, suite 66 passed.

Supplement stage DELETED. entity_symbol_join disposed by route 1: re-based on checks.SourceScan, an independent source-derived qualified-name walk, proved by breaking each side in turn plus the position, and by a test pinning that checks.py borrows no naming code from extract.py. tc34 closed and measured: 8 definitions gained, 0 lost. Real corpus check 6/6 exit 0; code_map suite 70 passed. The re-based check went red on the real corpus against its own first cut (a def inside an except handler), which is the proof it is consulting the source rather than itself.

Anchor comments become anchored statements; ids.jsonl is sorted {id, s} with no position. Mint-two-rename-one exercised, and the payoff proved: a 5-line insertion above an anchor moves the recorded definition line by exactly 5 and leaves ids.jsonl byte-identical. Duplicate slug fails the build. RED 5 failed at 70b60555, GREEN 5 passed at 68f4a2eb, code_map suite 75 passed.

Full suite 1767 passed / 2 skipped / 0 failed against a 1744 baseline; fresh build then check exit 0, 6/6 on the real corpus; the gate's own -k selector selects 21 tests, all of which were committed red before their fix. Work committed on issue-456/code-map across 11 commits, explicit paths only. IMPLEMENTER_RESULT written.
